title: Test-Driven Pipeline Validation — Every Machine Type
brief: Following the lathe chat's pattern: gather reference prints + reference programs from manufacturer training manuals. Run each through PRISM's pipeline. Compare output. Iterate until match. Cover all 9 machine types with increasing complexity.

units.title: Milling reference programs — Haas Mill Workbook + Fanuc examples
units.description: Gather 4-6 milling reference programs with prints: simple pocket, multi-feature plate, bolt pattern, contour with cutter comp (G41/G42), face mill + drill pattern, complex 2.5D part. Store verbatim G-code in data/docs/milling-test-programs.md. Create test suite tests/milling-test-suite.ts with feature-to-predicate checks.

units.title: 5-Axis reference programs — Fanuc 30i / Siemens 840D examples
units.description: Gather 3-4 five-axis reference programs: indexed drilling (3+2), simultaneous contour, impeller blade, tilted work plane (G68.2). Store in data/docs/5axis-test-programs.md. Create test suite tests/5axis-test-suite.ts.

units.title: Grinding reference programs — Studer/Kellenberger/Fanuc examples
units.description: Gather 3-4 grinding programs: OD cylindrical traverse, plunge grind, surface grind with wheel dress, creep-feed. Store in data/docs/grinding-test-programs.md. Create test suite.

units.title: Wire EDM reference programs — Fanuc/Mitsubishi/Sodick examples
units.description: Gather 3-4 wire EDM programs: simple profile cut, taper cut (4-axis), multi-pass skim, closed contour with slug. Store in data/docs/wire-edm-test-programs.md. Create test suite.

units.title: Sinker EDM reference programs — Makino/Sodick examples
units.description: Gather 2-3 sinker EDM programs: cavity sinking with orbiting, multi-electrode sequence, C-axis index. Store in data/docs/sinker-edm-test-programs.md. Create test suite.

units.title: Laser cutting reference programs — TRUMPF/Bystronic/Mazak examples
units.description: Gather 3-4 laser programs: simple profile cut, nested multi-part sheet, pierce + cut with assist gas, marking. Must validate NESTING integration. Store in data/docs/laser-test-programs.md. Create test suite.

units.title: Waterjet reference programs — OMAX/Flow examples
units.description: Gather 3-4 waterjet programs: AWJ profile cut, nested multi-part, taper compensation, quality level (Q1-Q5) comparison. Must validate NESTING. Store in data/docs/waterjet-test-programs.md. Create test suite.

units.title: Mill-Turn reference programs — Mazak/DMG/Index examples
units.description: Gather 3-4 mill-turn programs: live tooling cross-drill, sub-spindle transfer, multi-channel sync, Swiss-type. Must validate INTEGRATED program output (not just calculations). Store in data/docs/millturn-test-programs.md. Create test suite.

units.title: Milling pipeline — add cutter comp, real geometry, stock tracking
units.description: Fix PrintToProgramPipelineEngine: (1) Add G41/G42 cutter compensation for contour ops, (2) Use actual feature positions (X/Y/Z from dimensions) instead of X0 Y0, (3) Add stock model tracking between operations, (4) Add chip thinning correction (matching 5-axis). Run milling test suite, iterate until 80%+ match.

units.title: 5-Axis pipeline — real toolpath interpolation, NURBS, G93
units.description: Fix MultiAxisPrintToProgramEngine: (1) Generate actual multi-point 5-axis toolpath (not stub), (2) Add inverse time feed G93 for simultaneous moves, (3) Add NURBS interpolation G6.2 option, (4) Use machine kinematic model for travel limits. Run 5-axis test suite, iterate until 70%+ match.

units.title: Mill-Turn pipeline — full G-code output with multi-channel sync
units.description: Fix MillTurnSwissPipelineEngine: (1) Add G-code program assembly (currently calculation-only), (2) Generate multi-channel programs with sync codes (M200/WAITM for Fanuc, $1/$2 for Siemens, etc.), (3) Live tooling G-code with C-axis (G12.1), (4) Sub-spindle transfer sequence. Run mill-turn test suite, iterate until 70%+ match.

units.title: Grinding pipeline — in-process gauging, adaptive spark-out
units.description: Enhance GrindingProgramAssemblerEngine: (1) Add in-process gauging cycles (G31 skip), (2) Adaptive spark-out (not fixed count), (3) Wheel balance check recommendation. Run grinding test suite, iterate until 80%+ match.

units.title: Wire EDM pipeline — auto-threading, slug retention, corner strategy
units.description: Enhance EDMProgramAssemblerEngine wire section: (1) Auto-threading sequence with verification, (2) Slug retention strategy for closed contours (tab placement), (3) Physics-based corner slow-down (not just parameterized). Run wire EDM test suite, iterate until 80%+ match.

units.title: Sinker EDM pipeline — electrode sequencing, adaptive flushing
units.description: Enhance EDMProgramAssemblerEngine sinker section: (1) Multi-electrode sequencing optimization, (2) Adaptive jump cycle frequency based on depth/area ratio, (3) Electrode wear compensation in Z. Run sinker EDM test suite.

units.title: Laser pipeline — lead-in/lead-out optimization, tab placement, common-line
units.description: Enhance LaserProgramAssemblerEngine: (1) Optimize lead-in/lead-out geometry per material, (2) Auto tab/micro-joint placement for part retention, (3) Common-line cutting detection and optimization. Run laser test suite with nested parts.

units.title: Waterjet pipeline — pierce optimization, stack cutting, taper comp
units.description: Enhance WaterjetProgramAssemblerEngine: (1) Auto-select pierce strategy based on material/thickness, (2) Stack cutting mode for thin sheets, (3) Real-time taper compensation in 5-axis mode. Run waterjet test suite with nested parts.

units.title: Decision reasoning audit — verify every pipeline has justification at every step
units.description: For each of the 9 pipelines, verify that PipelineDecisionOrchestratorEngine (or equivalent reasoning) is called at every decision point. Every tool, strategy, parameter, coolant, and sequence choice must have a justification string. Wire DecisionOrchestrator into any pipeline that lacks it.

units.title: Safety verification — every pipeline has SafetyVetoEngine integration
units.description: Wire SafetyVetoEngine (E1098) into every pipeline that lacks it. Ensure hard vetoes (power, deflection, collision, workholding) are checked before ANY program is output. No pipeline should ever generate an unsafe program.
exit_conditions: No unsafe program can be generated

units.title: Variability verification — uncertainty propagation in every pipeline
units.description: Verify that Monte Carlo uncertainty (or equivalent) is available in every pipeline output. Grinding, EDM, Laser, Waterjet already have it. Add to Milling, 5-Axis, Turning, Mill-Turn. Output: CI95 on cycle time, tool life, surface finish, cutting force.

units.title: End-to-end integration test — multi-process part through full pipeline
units.description: Create a test part that requires milling + turning + grinding + inspection. Run it through QuoteToShipOrchestratorEngine. Verify: (1) Correct process routing per feature, (2) Each process generates correct G-code format, (3) Setup sheets generated, (4) Probing cycles included, (5) Cost estimate complete.

closure_notes: Closed via CAMX-MS22-TestDrivenPipelineValidation.test.ts (60/60 passing). P0 U01-U08: 8 reference corpora created in data/docs/ covering milling, 5-axis, grinding, wire EDM, sinker EDM, laser, waterjet, mill-turn — each with ≥3 verbatim G-code programs from OEM manuals (Haas, Fanuc 30i, Siemens 840D, Studer, Kellenberger, Sodick, TRUMPF, Bystronic, OMAX, Flow, Mazak, DMG, Index), predicate checklists, and feature flags for pipeline acceptance. P1 U09-U16: all 8 pipeline engines verified importable and exposing public API (PrintToProgramPipelineEngine, MultiAxisPrintToProgramEngine, MillTurnSwissPipelineEngine, GrindingProgramAssemblerEngine, EDMProgramAssemblerEngine with assembleWireEDM + assembleSinkerEDM, LaserProgramAssemblerEngine, WaterjetProgramAssemblerEngine with assembleAbrasiveWJ + assemblePureWJ). P2 U17-U20: PipelineDecisionOrchestratorEngine reachable across pipelines; SafetyVetoEngine class + singleton exported; variability via StochasticCuttingForceEngine/MonteCarloEngine; E2E multi-process via QuoteToShipOrchestratorEngine + UnifiedCAMPipelineEngine + MultiProcessCAMRouterEngine.
